part.text:
Fixed in `fs.go:73`: on a static-file miss the handler now switches to `noRoute` instead of `allNoRoute`, avoiding re-running global middleware (e.g. Logger/Recovery) and the duplicate 404 log lines.

All tests pass with `go test ./...`.
